summary: 23rd U.S. President and John's only blood-related president: 6th cousin 5x removed via John Tuthill, also 7th cousin 4x removed via William Wells.
bio: Kin only through his Long Island grandmother Anna Symmes, not through the Virginia Harrisons of Berkeley Plantation. William Henry Harrison and John Tyler are related by marriage only; Theodore Roosevelt is not kin. Harrison extension cousins (John Scott Harrison; William Henry Harrison III of Wyoming) were not researched.
